# Penida

> French startup studio building SaaS products and Shopify apps. Founded by Marc and Charles.

Updated: September 23, 2026. Product features and pricing are maintained on each product’s official website.

## Studio

- [Official reference](https://penida.io/ai.md): Studio facts, current products and portfolio updates.
- [Homepage](https://penida.io/index.md): Studio presentation and app directory.
- [Contact](mailto:penidastudio@gmail.com): General enquiries.

## Articles

- [How to Launch a Shopify App: The Complete Guide](https://penida.io/blog/how-to-launch-a-shopify-app.md): From a merchant problem to a working app, a review-ready listing and a measurable launch.
- [15 Profitable Shopify App Ideas to Build in 2026](https://penida.io/blog/shopify-app-ideas.md): 15 directions to investigate, with a target merchant, first version and validation question for each.
- [How to Get Your First 1,000 Users for a Shopify App](https://penida.io/blog/first-1000-users-shopify-app.md): A practical framework for activation, honest reviews, content, partnerships and retained usage.
